note: Generated from OPM's flowexp_comp. Mole fractions are XMF (liquid), YMF (vapour) and ZMF (overall), indexed 1..N in the deck's CNAMES order. OIL_DEN, GAS_DEN, OIL_VISC and GAS_VISC are requested by the deck's RPTRST but are written as zeros by this simulator, so they are NOT usable as reference values; the same is true of FPR and every block summary vector.
